endorsements.name: Mohit Aghera
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-27909
endorsements.description: For Mautic versions prior to 3.3.4/4.0.0, there is an XSS vulnerability on Mautic's password reset page where a vulnerable parameter, "bundle," in the URL could allow an attacker to execute Javascript code. The attacker would be required to convince or trick the target into clicking a password reset URL with the vulnerable parameter utilized.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.3)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Mohit Aghera
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-27913
endorsements.description: The function mt_rand is used to generate session tokens, this function is cryptographically flawed due to its nature being one pseudorandomness, an attacker can take advantage of the cryptographically insecure nature of this function to enumerate session tokens for accounts that are not under his/her control This issue affects: Mautic Mautic versions prior to 3.3.4; versions prior to 4.0.0.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.5)
